qa_pairs.question: How is Ansys Fluent launched for a single-node parallel job using Intel MPI on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: For a single-node parallel job on Alliance clusters, Ansys Fluent is launched using the command `fluent -g $MYVERSION -t $NCORES -mpi=intel -pshmem -i $MYJOURNALFILE`. This command utilizes shared memory parallel (pshmem) with Intel MPI.

qa_pairs.question: What are the differences in launching a multi-node Ansys Fluent job using Intel MPI on the Nibi cluster compared to other Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: For multi-node Ansys Fluent jobs, a machine file is generated by `slurm_hl2hl.py`. If the cluster is Nibi, Fluent is launched using Intel MPI with Ethernet-based communication (`-peth`) via the command `fluent -g $MYVERSION -t $NCORES -mpi=intel -peth -cnf=/tmp/machinefile-$SLURM_JOB_ID -i $MYJOURNALFILE`. For other Alliance clusters, it uses InfiniBand-based communication (`-pib`) with the command `fluent -g $MYVERSION -t $NCORES -mpi=intel -pib -cnf=/tmp/machinefile-$SLURM_JOB_ID -i $MYJOURNALFILE`.
